provenance.binding_core: vendored core (neoantigen-io-response not staged; identical real-data-only semantics)

tesla_features.reference: Wells DK et al., Cell 2020, DOI:10.1016/j.cell.2020.09.015 (TESLA)

features.tumor_abundance: gene TPM x VAF; expr floor 5.0 TPM, VAF floor 0.05
features.agretopicity: WT %rank / mut %rank (recognition); mutant binding >= WT scores high (differential agretopicity; Ghorani/TESLA recognition axis)
features.foreignness: local Smith-Waterman (BLOSUM62) similarity to known immunogenic IEDB epitopes AND dissimilarity to the human self-proteome; after Luksza et al. 2017 (doi:10.1038/nature24473) and Richman et al. 2019 (doi:10.1016/j.cels.2019.08.009). None if reference sets unavailable.
features.binding_stability: MHCflurry presentation-score proxy (or NetMHCstabpan half-life if available)
features.fraction_hydrophobic: fraction of Kyte-Doolittle-hydrophobic residues in the peptide
features.mutation_position: 1-based position of the mutation; anchors (P2, P-Omega) penalised

recognition_references: Luksza M et al., Nature 2017, doi:10.1038/nature24473 (neoantigen fitness / foreignness)
Richman LP et al., Cell Systems 2019, doi:10.1016/j.cels.2019.08.009 (dissimilarity-to-self)
IEDB: Vita R et al., NAR 2019, doi:10.1093/nar/gky1006 (immunogenic reference epitopes)
tesla_features.note: Defined prioritization score, NOT a validated clinical immunogenicity probability.

_note_candidates_trimmed: For package size, this analysis.json embeds all 1038 prioritized candidates plus the 200 top-ranked of each exclusion class. The COMPLETE 8009 candidates are in neoantigens.csv (same directory).
